public.text: The governance/runtime/content three-layer model introduced here is not cross-referenced to the strategic/operational governance split from 3.4.3–3.4.4, nor to the escalation pathway defined in 3.4.4 (363–372), leaving unclear which body decides major semantic changes versus routine terminology curation.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a sentence mapping the "governance layer" to strategic and/or operational governance (e.g. "routine content review sits within operational governance; changes that expand SGI's scope or affect multiple registries escalate to strategic governance per 3.4.4").
